signature.one_line: Locked same-mark team lineup dissolving every ~42 frames under a fixed text colour serif Hinglish offer.
unique_devices: Same-mark person swap: locked camera and identical medium framing, a new team member replaces the last every ~42 frames via ~6-frame dissolves (5 people)
Identical micro-action per person: eyes closed or looking down, then eyes open and a small smile within ~24 frames of their shot
One persistent 2-line Roman-script Hinglish offer in text colour condensed serif across the chest, line 2 ~1.2x larger than line 1, no stroke or box
signature.why_it_works: The offer is readable in the viewer's own register from frame one; the swaps show team size and warmth without any B-roll or speech.

hook.first_frame: Centred medium shot of one team member with eyes closed in front of a single-colour building backdrop; text colour 2-line offer across the chest

structure.what: Person 1 opens eyes and smiles; offer line already on screen
Persons 2-4 dissolve in on the same mark, same action, ~42 frames each
Person 5 after a hard cut, same action; offer still on screen

background_text.how: Roman Hinglish, sentence case, no punctuation, ~5 + 3 words; text colour condensed serif; line 1 centre 52.0 % H (x 13-88 %), line 2 centre 57.7 % H (x 20-82 %), line 2 ~1.2x larger; static from frame 0 to the last frame, untouched by the dissolves; optional slight bulge warp

layout.what: Centred medium shot on a fixed mark
layout.how: Subject centred, head in the upper third, chest at 45-60 % H under the text; same single-colour backdrop in every shot

camera.how: Tripod or steady phone, identical framing for every person; no punch-ins

transitions.how: ~6-frame cross-dissolve between people on the same spot (75 % of changes soft)
Hard cut to the last person

other_text_spec.copy: offer in Roman-script Hinglish, 2 lines (~5 + 3 words), sentence case per line, no punctuation (placeholder 'Lead words here' / 'KEY WORD')
other_text_spec.font_class: condensed transitional serif, regular weight, moderate contrast, bracketed serifs, tall ascenders; slight bulge warp (line ends compressed)

layout.note: line 2 ~1.2x larger than line 1; line 1 descenders nearly touch line 2 ascenders

other_text_spec.fit_note: original is a condensed serif (width/height ratio 0.71-0.76 of Playfair): balanced Playfair sizes 76 / 88 px; exact look Playfair 95 / 115 px with scaleX(0.74), or Instrument Serif sized to the measured ink

animation.entry: on screen from frame 0, no animation
animation.idle: static, not tracked; fixed through the person-swap dissolves

style.look_intent: mid-contrast, natural saturation, cool: daylight, one cool single-colour backdrop, true skin tones

sound.music: trending song only, no voice (speech_coverage 0.26 is the sung lyric); beat periodicity 0.28, ~67 bpm estimate; very steady (loudness range 0.7 LU)
sfx: none; the single hard cut is not on an onset (measured cut_hit_share 0.0)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Offer / Sale Announcement
catalog_styles.role: one-line offer as the whole message

use_when: the user has 4-6 team members who can each stand on the same spot for a few seconds
the message is a single short offer or invitation (apply, send CV, join, book)
no one wants to speak on camera; music only
the audience reads Roman-script Hinglish (or swap to the brand's language)
avoid_when: the message needs explanation or proof
tight close-ups where the text would cover the mouth
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B16 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B16.json) to this brand.
This blueprint has NO speech captions: one fixed 2-line offer title over a locked-off same-mark team lineup. Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{TEXT}} has no stroke or box, so it must stay >= 3:1 against the clothing/backdrop behind it; add a 2 px dark outline only if it drops below)
- {{TEXT}}: offer lines, default #FFDF00
- {{ACCENT}}: same as {{TEXT}} (no emphasis word in the source), default #FFDF00
- {{ACCENT_2}}: unused, default none
- {{SURFACE}}: unused (backdrop is the real location: one strong single-colour wall/facade), default none
- {{CARD_BG}}: unused, default none
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: condensed transitional serif, default Playfair Display 400 (Instrument Serif closer)
- {{FONT_BODY}}: same as {{FONT_DISPLAY}}
- {{HANDLE}}: not shown in the source
- {{LOGO}}: not shown in the source

TITLE
1. Copy: the offer in the audience's register (source: Roman-script Hinglish), 2 lines, ~5 + 3 words, sentence case, no punctuation ("Lead words here" / "KEY WORD").
2. {{FONT_DISPLAY}} in {{TEXT}}, tracking 0, no stroke/shadow/box. Line 1 76 px, line 2 88 px (~1.2x). Exact narrow look: Playfair 95 / 115 px with transform: scaleX(0.74), or Instrument Serif sized to the measured ink.
3. Layout: both lines centred; line 1 centre 52.0 % H (x 13-88 %, ink ~4.8 % H at ~24 characters), line 2 centre 57.7 % H (x 20-82 %, ink ~5.82 % H at ~17 characters), across the chest of a centred medium shot. Optional slight bulge warp.
4. Timing: on from frame 0 to the last frame, static, untouched by the dissolves.

EDIT
5. Locked camera, identical medium framing, one strong single-colour backdrop. 5 people on the same mark, ~42 frames each; swaps are ~6-frame cross-dissolves, the last change a hard cut. Each person: eyes closed / looking down, then eyes open + small smile within ~24 frames. No punch-ins, no end card.

SOUND: one trending/upbeat song, no voice, steady level. Master to about -14 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP.
GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: mid-contrast, natural saturation, cool daylight with true skin.

VERIFY before rendering: render the two lines and measure:
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at 1.0 --box 0.08,0.48,0.92,0.545 --ink "#FFDF00:75"
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at 1.0 --box 0.08,0.548,0.92,0.61 --ink "#FFDF00:75"
Swap the --ink colour to {{TEXT}}. Compute the expected ink height/width of the brand's actual lines with video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py (76 / 88 px, or 95 / 115 px x scaleX 0.74); if height fits but width is too wide, apply the scaleX. Line centres within +-1 % of frame height of 52.0 / 57.7 %.
